# BacksterOS documentation index
# Workspace: ~/code/backsteros/
# For AI agents: load AGENTS.md first, then fetch only the docs relevant to your task.

> Code: core/, mobile/, backsteros/, agents/, backsterdev/, backstermeet/, backsterdesign/

## Entry points

- [STRUCTURE.md](../STRUCTURE.md): Folder map
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): Primary agent entry — rules, task→doc map, phase gate
- [README.md](../README.md): Human overview
- [backstermeet/AGENTS.md](../backstermeet/AGENTS.md): BacksterMeet — Tauri 2 Director (host) app for live meetings; LiveKit, meetings API, secrets, open gaps

## Specifications

- [docs/00-vision.md](00-vision.md): Goals, users, non-goals, success criteria
- [docs/01-architecture.md](01-architecture.md): System diagram, repos, auth, write pipeline
- [docs/02-tech-stack.md](02-tech-stack.md): Tool choices — Expo, Tauri, Postgres, PowerSync, Meilisearch, Hono
- [docs/03-data-model.md](03-data-model.md): Sync tiers A/B/C/D, entities, version fields
- [docs/04-api-and-sync.md](04-api-and-sync.md): REST v1, sync bootstrap/pull/push, live documents, agent API (dual-hydrate **deprecated** — see 16)
- [docs/16-linear-shaped-sync.md](16-linear-shaped-sync.md): Target Linear-style sync — cloud leader, product shells on cloud PowerSync, optional Mac replica, R2 files (ADR-035)
- [docs/17-desktop-without-docker.md](17-desktop-without-docker.md): Why Docker is not the default to open desktop; boot graph, gaps, slice 1 (ADR-035 addendum)
- [docs/19-penpot-integration.md](19-penpot-integration.md): BacksterDESIGN — Penpot fork under backsterdesign/ (local devenv via `@backsteros/design`, runtime map) + BacksterOS integration: identity, MCP/webhooks, design→code, R2, branding, task mapping, deploy, open gaps
- [docs/20-repo-structure.md](20-repo-structure.md): Repo folder reorganization — backsteros/ (was desktop/), backsterdev/ (was development/), backstermeet/ added (from ~/code/backstermeet), hub/ removed; backsterdesign/→backsterdesign/; open point on local core placement
- [docs/21-deployment.md](21-deployment.md): Deployment decision record — `deploy/deploy` CLI (--all / --server / --<section>), server map (production / lemodesign / development), per-section plan, Penpot → lemodesign via GHCR, open decisions; not built yet
- [docs/06-storage-and-search.md](06-storage-and-search.md): Vault layout today; private R2 target (ADR-035)
- [docs/13-hybrid-cloud-local-core.md](13-hybrid-cloud-local-core.md): Current hybrid behavior; target routing is ADR-035 / 16
- [docs/14-client-logic-inventory.md](14-client-logic-inventory.md): Mobile ↔ desktop pure-logic mirrors (contracts extraction backlog)
- [docs/15-tauri-ipc-profiling.md](15-tauri-ipc-profiling.md): Desktop invoke/event inventory, batching gate, system-stats watch
- [docs/05-clients.md](05-clients.md): Desktop, mobile, agents door, portal
- [docs/11-urls-and-routing.md](11-urls-and-routing.md): Local-core, agent.backsteros.com, retired 410 hosts
- [docs/07-performance.md](07-performance.md): iPhone 16, M1 MacBook, lightweight rules
- [docs/08-legacy-circle.md](08-legacy-circle.md): Circle monolith reference, migration notes
- [docs/09-phased-build-plan.md](09-phased-build-plan.md): Implementation phases 0–9
- [docs/10-decisions-log.md](10-decisions-log.md): ADRs
- [docs/12-v2-local-computer.md](12-v2-local-computer.md): v2 local-computer core + Expo/Tauri shells (current ops; target is ADR-035)

## Task routing (quick)

| If you are working on… | Read |
| --- | --- |
| Starting implementation | 00-vision, 12-v2-local-computer, 09-phased-build-plan |
| API routes / OpenAPI | 04-api-and-sync, 03-data-model, 02-tech-stack |
| Email drafts (PATCH body fields) | 04-api-and-sync (Email agent / draft PATCH — `body`/`to`/`cc`/`subject` only) |
| Task description/comment images (agents) | 04-api-and-sync (OS-90), agents/README.md, 03-data-model (`task_images`) |
| PowerSync / offline | 03-data-model, **16-linear-shaped-sync**, **17-desktop-without-docker**, 04-api-and-sync, 07-performance |
| Expo mobile | 05-clients, 07-performance, 04-api-and-sync, 12-v2-local-computer, 14-client-logic-inventory |
| Tauri desktop | 05-clients, 07-performance, 10-decisions-log (ADR-019, ADR-020, ADR-035), **16-linear-shaped-sync**, **17-desktop-without-docker**, 15-tauri-ipc-profiling |
| PDFs / markdown / search | 06-storage-and-search, 10-decisions-log (ADR-035), 03-data-model |
| Changing stack choices | 10-decisions-log, 02-tech-stack |
| BacksterDESIGN / Penpot fork | **19-penpot-integration**, `backsterdesign/BACKSTER.md`, `tooling/design/` |
| BacksterMeet / live meetings / LiveKit Director | `backstermeet/AGENTS.md`, 05-clients (portal), **20-repo-structure** §8 (open gaps) |
| Social / Zernio / owned accounts | 03-data-model (Social entities), 10-decisions-log (ADR-036), `core/server/src/social/` |

## Conventions

- Do not revive archived v1 Next apps (`~/code/archive/backsteros-legacy/`)
- Never bulk-sync Tier C/D content to clients
- Business logic in `core/server/` only
- No shared visual UI between mobile and desktop
- All writes: storage → Postgres version → sync event → Meilisearch → realtime
